prompt: Rendered in a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling construction site. On the far left, a worker in a yellow hard hat stands firmly on uneven ground. Next to him, a rusty shovel leans precariously against a stack of gray bricks. In the center foreground, a foreman in an orange vest points assertively toward the horizon. Beside the foreman, a clipboard rests open on a wooden crate. A junior engineer in blue overalls looks at the clipboard intently while holding a pen. To the right of the engineer, a large cement mixer sits idle with its drum tilted upward. Perched atop the mixer, a stray cat with black and white fur watches the activity below. Near the mixer, a bucket of wet concrete spills slightly onto the dirt. Behind the bucket, a senior architect in a suit gestures toward the building frame. The building frame itself rises in the background, composed of steel beams and scaffolding. Hanging from the scaffolding, a safety harness dangles loosely in the breeze. Below the harness, a pile of coiled ropes lies tangled on the ground. Next to the ropes, a pair of work boots sits empty and dusty. On the far right, a security guard in a dark uniform observes the perimeter. Leaning against a fence post near the guard, a bicycle with a broken chain waits for repair.
